query: 供应商环境标准 供应商环境标准 衡量供应链环境准入标准与约束机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的供应商环境准入标准（含碳足迹、排污等硬性指标）；实行动态环境分级管理，并根据分级结果执行差异化采购政策；有明确的违规处理机制（如红线淘汰制）。 • 1分（合格）：发布了供应商行为准则，包含基础的环境保护要求，具备初次准入的环境审核，但缺乏动态分级管理或明确的违规退出机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无供应商环境标准披露，或仅笼统提及“推行绿色采购”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署环境协议或执行环境标准的供应商数量（或采购额）占比 >80%。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对一级供应商/关键原材料供应商执行，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商环境标准 绿色采购 供应商行为准则 环境准入 供应商环境审核 分级管理 环境黑名单 供应商退出机制 supplier environmental standards green procurement supplier code of conduct environmental prequalification supplier environmental audit tiered supplier management environmental blacklist supplier exit mechanism 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商环境标准'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“绿色采购”；仅有企业自身环境政策；仅有供应商劳工准则而无环境条款；仅有一次性供应商培训活动；区分：本指标聚焦供应链环境准入与约束；供应商行为准则可能同时含劳工与环境，需抽出环境条款；企业环境政策不等于已对供应商设硬性标准；道德采购更偏人权/合规采购。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

[Content]
As we continue to roll out new initiatives to reduce the environmental footprint of our products, we recognise that engaging with our suppliers is crucial to meeting our goals. Since FY2020, we have issued formal letters with our Green Product and Process requirements to all our suppliers and requested a yearly report from them on their environmental performance, including their carbon footprint. On an ongoing basis, we also consult with key suppliers and welcome their ideas on how our products and processes can be made more sustainable.

results.text: Transition risks Changes in regulations | As China seeks to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060, many industries have been affected by new regulations such as energy efficiency benchmarks. As Home Control has manufacturing facilities in China, our manufacturing costs may increase as a result. Home Control frequently monitors the regulatory changes under current ISO14001 system requirements. Additionally, we conduct cross function assessments against the latest regulatory changes reported by third-party service agency such as SGS Hong Kong Limited. Changes in consumer expectations | There is a growing consciousness of environmental issues among consumers around the world. Accordingly, we may be affected by an increase in demand for environmentally- friendly products, and would need to ensure that we are well-positioned to turn this into a business opportunity. Currently, one of our key perpetual targets is to meet our customers' environmental requirements related to their products. Home Control has also dedicated an Environmental and Sustainability team to manage customer's environmental requirements on product level. Furthermore, a cross function 'Green Team' has been established for the study and implementation of environmentally friendly technologies and new materials on our product. Physical risks Extreme weather events | The sixth assessment report by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has indicated that at the current rate of global warming, there would likely be an increased frequency of extreme weather events. For Home Control, this could mean potential disruptions in our supply chains. With regards to the management of supply chain disruption risks due to extreme weather events, Home Control has implemented/in the process of implementing the following: • Contingency plans to buffer from the effects of sudden bad weather events. The addition cost of production from contingency plan will be included in the Bill of Materials (BOM). • Supply risks assessment and tracking system that has been developed to help monitor and detect abnormal situation.

To reduce the impact of our products on the environment and mitigate the potential climate-related risks identified, Home Control has formed a committee and set policies to recommend the use of recycled materials and PCR resin in products to customers. In the year, we managed to increase the ratio of PCR resin within our products by 2.09% from FY2020, thereby reducing CO 2 emissions by 11.38 tonnes. [Content]
Currently, there is a high composition of plastic material in our products, with plastic making up 30 to 40% of our final product by weight, contributing to high CO 2 emissions. To reduce the impact of our products on the environment and mitigate the potential climate-related risks identified, Home Control has formed a committee and set policies to recommend the use of recycled materials and PCR resin in products to customers. In the year, we managed to increase the ratio of PCR resin within our products by 2.09% from FY2020, thereby reducing CO 2 emissions by 11.38 tonnes. We currently also have a strong business continuity plan for our supply chains, described on page 19 of this report, under 'Supply chains and Business continuity'.

WASTE

[Content]
All our hazardous waste (such as waste printed circuit boards) is treated by a qualified third-party company. In FY2021, 35,315 kg of such waste was generated (FY2020: 41,370 kg). The decrease in hazardous waste was mostly due to the fall in production quantity due to COVID-19. In FY2021, our hazardous waste production intensity was 280.26 kg/ US$M of revenue (FY2020: 308.30 kg/US$M of revenue). Furthermore, all our chemical containers are recycled by our suppliers. We continue to work with our partners to ensure that their management of hazardous waste in relation to our products was in line with environmental regulations such as the Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS). In FY2021, we achieved our target of 100% compliance with environmental regulations and reduced hazardous waste intensity by 1% from FY2020.
